title: Speed Run: The Behaviorist, Gestalt & Cognitive Revolutions

questions.question: What was the fundamental premise of John B. Watson's 1913 Behaviorist Manifesto?

options.text: Psychology must abandon the study of consciousness and restrict itself strictly to observable behavior
Psychology should focus exclusively on dream interpretation
Introspection is the most reliable scientific method
Rats have no ability to learn

questions.explanation: Watson rejected mentalism and introspection, insisting that psychology study only observable behavior.

questions.question: Which reinforcement schedule produces high, steady rates of response that are exceptionally resistant to extinction, as seen in slot machines?
questions.explanation: Variable Ratio delivers rewards after an unpredictable number of responses, creating persistent, extinction-resistant behavior.

questions.question: What phenomenon did Max Wertheimer describe in 1912 where alternating stationary flashing lights produce the perception of smooth motion?
questions.explanation: The Phi Phenomenon proved that apparent motion is perceived as an organized whole, launching Gestalt psychology.

questions.question: In Carl Rogers's Person-Centered Therapy, what is Unconditional Positive Regard?

options.text: Warm, non-judgmental acceptance of the client's inherent value as a human being
Delivering candy rewards for positive self-talk
Telling clients their dreams are prophecies
Demanding that clients obey therapist instructions

questions.explanation: Unconditional Positive Regard provides total acceptance without conditions of worth, enabling personal growth.

questions.question: What did Noam Chomsky argue against B.F. Skinner regarding human language acquisition?

options.text: Children possess innate cognitive language faculties (Universal Grammar) that cannot be explained by operant S-R chaining
Language is learned exclusively through food rewards
Humans only speak when conditioned by shock collars

questions.explanation: Chomsky showed that language generation is creative and guided by an innate Language Acquisition Device, disproving radical behaviorist accounts.

questions.question: What is the capacity of human short-term working memory according to George A. Miller's 1956 research?
questions.explanation: Miller established that short-term memory has an informational bottleneck of 7 ± 2 items (5 to 9 chunks).

questions.question: What neurophysiological principle formulated by Donald Hebb in 1949 explains how learning strengthens synaptic connections?

options.text: 'The whole is other than the sum'

questions.explanation: Hebb proposed that correlated firing between pre- and post-synaptic neurons strengthens synaptic efficiency.

questions.question: What major neuropsychological double dissociation was established through Brenda Milner's testing of Patient H.M.?

options.text: Conscious declarative memory (hippocampus-dependent) is anatomically and functionally distinct from procedural motor memory
Vision is processed in the frontal lobes

questions.explanation: H.M.'s preserved motor learning despite dense anterograde amnesia proved that declarative and procedural memory depend on distinct neural circuits.
